Class AuthResponse<T>

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.security.extension.exception.AuthResponse<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of the data payload
public class AuthResponse<T> extends Object
Generic response envelope returned by the authentication and authorisation layers to API clients.

Each instance is an immutable quadruple of (code, status, message, data) with a settable data payload for late-binding scenarios. The accompanying static factory methods (success, fail, of) provide a fluent way to build typical responses and convert the envelope into a Map via toMap() for direct serialisation.

Since:
3.0.0
Author:
[@Loong Wan](https://github.com/loong10k)
